Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", "{\"hidden_content\":\"Reachable\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
